transcript.answer: The OpenTelemetry JS metrics API has no proxy meter. If you create an instrument at module import, it comes from the global no-op meter provider, because the real MeterProvider hasn't been registered yet. Registering the provider later doesn't rebind that instrument, so it stays a no-op and records nothing. lore-api's counters were permanent no-ops for this reason. The fix in Lore (PR #2652, the ADR-050 metrics stack) was to resolve instruments lazily against metrics.getMeterProvider() when they are first used, rather than creating them at import.
